notes.title: FAERIE SOLITAIRE HARVEST LIBRARY UPDATE
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34607415/b8565891ea13bb5dbed156e0ebd73da4347a7b5a.png

If you have not reviewed FSH yet please do! Every review counts and is greatly appreciated! Total reviews help drive sales, which means more free updates like this one are possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/348910/Faerie_Solitaire_Harvest/

We've been hard at work since launch improving and polishing Faerie Solitaire Harvest to be even better than before. Besides tons of extra attention to detail and optimizations, we've also included an entirely new section to the game we are calling the Library.

Behold the exciting new additions of this update:

 - New Talents where you can gain new powerful abilities.
 - New Lore to discover as you play the game.
 - New Valor for greater risk and reward.

Unlock the Blab talent ASAP! :)

-------------------

Want the patch notes? Here they are:


ENTER THE LIBRARY!
Unlock Powerful Talents! 
Discover Fascinating Lore! 
Show Your Valor!

__________________________________________________________

Goal Changes
- Changing "No Wild" to "Using a Wild".

- Added "Never Break a Combo", worth 1,000 pure.
- Added "Celestial" combo tier, worth 1,000 pure.

- Increasing "Using Wild" bonus from 100 to 150 pure.
- Increasing "No Spare" bonus from 100 pure to 200 pure.
- Increasing "No Deck" bonus from 100 pure to 500 pure.
- Increasing "All-Out" bonus from 1000 pure to 2000 pure.
- Increasing "Left over Deck" bonus multiplier from x5 to x10. Example: (26 cards in a deck = 260 pure).
- Increasing "Highest Combo" bonus multiplier from x10 to x15. Example: (22 combo = 330 pure).

__________________________________________________________

Drop changes
- Adjusted drop rates.
    - Decreased Pet drop rates ~5%.
    - Decreased Item drop rates ~2%.
    - Decreased Resource drop rates ~2%.
    - Decreased bonus from NGP bonus ~5%.
(Note these are done in part for the new talents buffing drop rates by a lot more.)

__________________________________________________________

Valor
- Added New Valor system.

Valor is an optional system that will allow players to give themselves a more difficult playthrough.

You must meet the conditions to unlock each of the 7 Valor perks.

Each Valor perk you have enabled will increase the maximum amount of XP you get per completed hand and other benifits.

__________________________________________________________

Valor XP/Leveling
- Added New XP/Leveling system.
    - Every level will grant players 1 Talent point.
    - After reaching level 100, your next level up will reset your level to 1 and give you 1 Prestige Level.

Currently Prestige Levels do not grant anything special and are just for bragging rights (you still gain a bonus per each normal level up).

__________________________________________________________

Talents
- Added New Talent system.

We've added in 36 Talents into the game. These Talents will buff various different parts of the game as you play.

You will need Talent points and pure to unlock Talent perks. The cost of talent points and pure will depend on the Talents' Rank.

Some Talent Perks can be upgraded past their initial rank.

You gain Talent points from completing locations (finishing all 9 hands and freeing the faerie or unlocking a loot box) and from leveling up.

Plus a ton of extra random polish, love, and care!



Please enjoy this update and look forward to our next game Dire.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/556530/Faerie_Solitaire_Dire/

Want to join our Discord community? Check the in game about screen for invite links!
